description: Renovate only updates GitHub Actions, on a schedule (the _update-github-actions Claude skill is the on-demand equivalent), and merges them into main without a PR once CI passes on the renovate/* branch. npm dependencies and agent skills are updated by the update-dependencies workflow.

packageRules.description: changesets/action holds contents: write and the npm trusted publishing token, and CI never runs it: its updates get a PR that needs a review. It has its own group because one update that is not auto-merged holds back its whole group.
